findings.issue: נא is an entreaty particle; each «ahora» adds a temporal now and leaves the request unexpressed.
Both verbs are qal perfect 2ms; «perdona» and «herédanos» are imperatives and change that perfect force. Person, number, qal, and the 1cp object stay.

notes: Jussive ande, Señor mío, dual ojos, verbless él, and both singular sin nouns match the tokens.
